seoDescription: Jawab24 availability measured by UptimeRobot, an independent third-party monitor: {percent}% uptime over {days} days. See the live status page, and how we handle your data.
title: Trust & Reliability
intro: Choosing a service to answer your customers means trusting it to be there. So we do not ask you to take our word for it — availability is measured by an independent monitor, and its status page is public.
uptimeIncidents: {count, plural, one {# incident in the window} other {# incidents in the window}}

uptimeDowntime: {count, plural, one {# minute of downtime in total} other {# minutes of downtime in total}}
uptimeWorstCase: This is our lowest-scoring endpoint, not an average. The website itself recorded no downtime at all in this window — we publish the harder number, because the API is the part that answers your customers.
uptimeProvider: Measured by {provider}, an independent third-party monitoring service. We do not calculate this number ourselves.
uptimeCtaAria: Open the Jawab24 status page on {provider} in a new tab
uptimeDisclaimer: The figure above covers a fixed window and is refreshed periodically. The status page is live and always current.
measuredBody: Two endpoints are polled from outside our infrastructure every {minutes} minutes: the website customers visit, and the API that generates replies. A failure at either is recorded as downtime. Because the monitoring runs on {provider}'s servers rather than ours, an outage on our side cannot suppress the record of it.
transparencyBody: The same principle applies to what we hold. These documents state what we collect, why, and how to remove it — in plain language, not only in legal terms.
